Barbecue Teriyaki Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:48pm

Ingredients




24 sm. chicken drumsticks, or what's needed
Italian seasoning (enough to taste)
1/2 cup Kikkoman Lite Teriyaki Sauce
1/2 cup barbecue sauce
1/2 cup water

Preparation

1 Place chicken drumsticks in crock-pot. Season with Italian seasoning. Pour 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce over chicken and cook for 2 hours on low heat. When time is up, then add the barbecue sauce by mixing the barbecue sauce and water together. Pour over drumsticks. Cover and cook on low heat for 4 more hours. Serve chicken and sauce over rice or noodles.
